integrity: All theorem statements and closed-form Lyapunov entries are proved within the accompanying manuscript; finite floating-point checks only corroborate the proof. No independent scholarly or experimental verification has been performed. Earliest motivating public source is the original arXiv posting of 0901.4454 on 2009-01-28.
scientific_limitations: The expansion holds for fixed finite half-length L, nonzero homogeneous hopping g, positive central capture rate kappa, and independent uniform Markovian site dephasing gamma tending to zero; it does not provide a uniform L to infinity bound, finite-time optimum, disordered result, or a multiparticle theorem.
title: Universal weak-dephasing escape and its exact quadratic correction on mirror-protected quantum paths
